disorder-name.detail: Bipolar disorder; used as exemplar clinical cohort to validate normative model outputs
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we also included a sample of 56 adults with bipolar disorder (BD) and 26 healthy controls (HC-BD) from the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS); single site, UK
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "56 adults with bipolar disorder (BD) and 26 healthy controls (HC-BD) from the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)"

age.detail: Mean age and SD from Table 1; min/max not reported

sex.detail: Female count (35) and percentage (62%) from Table 1; male count estimated as N - female_n = 56 - 35 = 21

disorder-name.detail: Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy; used as exemplar clinical cohort to validate normative model outputs. Subgroups: left hemisphere seizure onset (n=74) and right hemisphere seizure onset (n=59)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A sample of 133 adults with mesial TLE (mTLE; n = 74 right hemisphere seizure onset; n = 59 left hemisphere seizure onset)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Imaging Database for Epilepsy and Surgery (IDEAS); acquired from the recent IDEAS dataset release (P. N. Taylor et al., 2024)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "133 adults with mesial TLE (mTLE; n = 74 right hemisphere seizure onset; n = 59 left hemisphere seizure onset) and 99 healthy controls (HC-mTLE) were acquired from the recent IDEAS dataset release"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from left mTLE (n=74, mean=36.0, SD=11.2) and right mTLE (n=59, mean=38.2, SD=10.8) subgroups reported in Table 1. Weighted mean = (74×36.0 + 59×38.2)/133 = 36.98; Pooled SD = sqrt((73×11.2² + 58×10.8²)/131) = 11.02. Min/max not reported.

sex.detail: Female counts from Table 1: left mTLE 43/74 (58%), right mTLE 39/59 (66%). Combined: female_n = 43+39 = 82, male_n = 133-82 = 51. Percentages calculated from combined totals.
